account_ref: private configured Gemini account; identifier withheld from public repository
command: credential-injected provider smoke + live integration/direct execution + python -m apex.bench --tasks benchmarks/tasks.json --timeout 90

resource_observations.execution: remote Gemini inference with local APEX tool execution
resource_observations.source_equivalence: Live acceptance ran on the modified working tree immediately before commit; the tree was committed without source changes and the repository was clean afterward.

cash_cost.note: Gemini API inference was explicitly authorized by the owner; no cost amount is inferred from quota or billing status.

failures.followup: A clean full rerun passed 12/12; the transient provider failure did not reproduce.

limitations: Acceptance is scoped to this exact APEX revision, Gemini model, SDK version, execution profile digest, direct host harness, and 12-task workload.
The first full benchmark attempt observed one redacted provider failure before planning; the clean rerun passed 12/12, so provider availability is not deterministic.
Exact per-run cash cost is not isolated from account billing.
The execution-profile digest binds the benchmark process configuration, not remote provider state or tool implementation code.
This validation does not establish exactly-once external effects, host-power-loss atomicity, independent assurance, or production deployment readiness.
